Risk is not merely an external threat; it is an inherent part of human existence. From the earliest civilizations to modern societies, progress has always demanded that individuals and communities confront challenges, make difficult choices, and accept a degree of uncertainty. - **Personal Responsibility:** If society removes every conceivable danger, it also removes the incentive for individuals to act prudently. Overprotection fosters dependence, eroding self-reliance—a cornerstone of a stable and dignified citizenry.
